mapper.select: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM sal_yt_order_sub_receive WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND order_sub_id = #{orderSubId}

SELECT -- sos.id as id, so.id as id, so.currency as currency, -- sos.sub_code as subCode, so.code as orderCode, so.platform_order_code as platformOrderCode, so.source_platform as sourcePlatform, so.sale_employee_id as saleEmployeeId, -- sos.receive_status as receiveStatus, so.receive_status as receiveStatus, so.receive_finish_time as receiveFinishTime, -- coalesce((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM sal_yt_order_sub_receive WHERE order_sub_id = sos.id AND is_deleted = 0),0) as totalReceiveAmount, coalesce((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM sal_yt_order_sub_receive WHERE order_id = so.id AND is_deleted = 0),0) as totalReceiveAmount, (select nick_name from sys_user where user_id = so.sale_employee_id) as saleEmployeeName, ( (select sum(price*number) from sal_yt_order_sub_item where order_sub_id = sos.id and is_deleted = 0) + (case when sos.is_collected_shipping_cost = 1 then coalesce(sos.shipping_cost, 0) else 0 end) ) as orderSubAmount FROM sal_yt_order_sub sos LEFT JOIN sal_yt_order so ON sos.order_id = so.id WHERE sos.is_deleted = 0 AND so.is_deleted = 0 and so.status=5 -- 只要已经申购的订单的
AND so.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{orderCode}, '%')
AND so.platform_order_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{platformOrderCode}, '%')
AND so.source_platform = #{platform}
AND so.sale_employee_id in(select user_id from sys_user where nick_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{salesEmployeeName}, '%') )
AND so.receive_status = #{receiveStatus}
ORDER BY sos.create_time DESC
select * from sal_yt_order_sub_receive where order_id=#{orderId} and is_deleted=0 limit 1
